how_today_transcript: So every Friday afternoon I open the bank app on my phone and go down the list of who paid. Then I open the invoice folder and anyone who hasn't paid in like three weeks I text them myself, something like hey just checking in on that invoice. If they don't answer I forget about it honestly until the next Friday. Twice a year somebody's like 90 days late and I only notice when I need the cash.

transcripts.sop-from-memo: Okay so when we do a water heater swap, first thing, you shut the water at the main and kill the breaker, don't trust the little valve. Drain it into the floor drain with the garden hose from the van. Disconnect, haul the old one out, new one in, new flex lines every time even if the old ones look fine. Fill it, bleed the air at the closest faucet, THEN power. Check for leaks after 20 minutes, not 2. Take the photo for the file. The thing guys forget is the expansion tank when there's a check valve on the main.
transcripts.hiring-ad: Last guy we hired said he had five years and couldn't sweat a joint. I need someone who can run a service call alone by month two. It's 7 to 4, Marietta and the north side, van provided, $28 to $34 an hour depending, weekends on rotation one in three.
transcripts.morning-brief: I read email in the truck at lights, which is dumb. I mostly want to know what's on fire and what's due.
